thread:
Emma_CS: quick recap from today's onboarding sweep — pulling out product asks and a couple renewal flags. TL;DR: 6 distinct asks, 2 customers showing friction.

Emma_CS: raw notes snippet attached (copied below). customers: NovaHealth, ParkCo, Brightlane.

Emma_CS: 1) Per-route billing toggle — ParkCo confused about per-route vs account billing, asking for UI toggle to disable route-level metering. :thinking:
Emma_CS: 2) Bulk label update in Console — NovaHealth imports lots of prompts, wants bulk tag/label apply for prompt sets.
Emma_CS: 3) SSO + SCIM provisioning — Brightlane needs SCIM for seats, currently manual invites are blocking rollout. :warning:
Emma_CS: 4) API error clarity — multiple customers report ambiguous 4xx messages on token expiry vs rate limit. Example from logs:
Lina_SE: ```{"error":"request failed","code":"invalid_request"}```
Lina_SE: suggest clearer error codes + doc snippet.
Emma_CS: 5) Model fallback transparency — customers want a dashboard showing when fallback model was used (helps trust).
Emma_CS: 6) Faster onboarding template for retrieval-based QA — request for sample prompt + eval harness.

Nora_CSManager: two flags to call out — NovaHealth is mid-contract renewal, citing onboarding delay; ParkCo is trialing but hit billing confusion (risk of churn).

Jason_PM: thanks — can we get quick priors? Which of the 6 are "must-fix before renewal" vs "nice to have"?

Emma_CS: my read: SSO/SCIM (Brightlane) = must, Per-route billing toggle (ParkCo) = must, NovaHealth bulk labels = high, API error clarity = high, model-fallback transparency = medium, onboarding template = low.

Harpreet_ProdOps: propose triage labels: P0 (blocker/renewal risk), P1 (high impact), P2 (medium), P3 (low). I'll add tags to our backlog.

Alex_ENG: quick Q on per-route billing toggle — is the ask purely UI toggling, or do they also need historical reconcilation?

Emma_CS: ParkCo asked for a toggle that stops new per-route charges rolling forward and a one-time reconciliation export. They want to flip it off today if possible.

Alex_ENG: recon + export likely >1 sprint. UI toggle to stop new attribution could be quick (P1 -> P0 if tied to renewal).

Jason_PM: OK. action items: 
- Harpreet: create backlog epic "CS feedback: onboarding + billing" and tag P0/P1 items (owner: Jason_PM).
- Alex_ENG: quick feasibility for UI toggle + estimated ETA by EOD tomorrow.
- Lina_SE: draft improved API error mapping doc + suggested error codes.
- Emma_CS / Nora_CSManager: schedule 30m catch-up with NovaHealth (renewal owner) and ParkCo (trial owner) — include clear mitigation steps.

Harpreet_ProdOps: created epic -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-5123 : added labels cs-feedback, billing, renewal-risk.

Lina_SE: pushed API errors doc PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/289 (contains example responses + suggested error code table).

Emma_CS: scheduled NovaHealth call for Wed 10am PT, ParkCo for Thu 2pm PT. Adding follow-up notes to the epic.

Jason_PM: thanks team. If we can get the UI toggle scoped to an MVP (prevent new per-route attribution + flag in admin) that's enough to de-risk ParkCo for the next 30d.

Alex_ENG: will prototype toggle behavior on private branch, pinging here when there's a build.

product-bot: deploy-bot: new branch build started for RED-5123 at 2148000340 (CI queued).

Emma_CS: nice — mark this thread resolved once owners are assigned in the epic. cc @Nora_CSManager for renewal tracking. :thumbsup:

Nora_CSManager: noted, will update renewal tracker and surface any new escalations in next sync.

Jason_PM: leaving a quick note to prioritize SSO/SCIM work adjacent to identity roadmap — Lina, can you add a short spec?

Lina_SE: on it — will post spec link in the epic by EOD.

Emma_CS: thanks everyone — feel free to DM if anything urgent pops up before calls.
